title: The derived local class on the fixed direct-image model
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $K\in D(\mathcal O_T)$. Use the fixed local-class and model comparisons [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. Write $I=I_K$ for the fixed K-injective representative of $K$, $B=g_*I$, $F$ for the underlying abelian presheaf-section functor on $S$, $b$ for topEdgeInverseModel, $\lambda$ for topEdgeLocalLeray, and $d:H^q(Rg_*K)\simeq H^q(B)$ for localClassDirectImageHomologyIso [def-weil-pbc-resolution-local-class-edge]. Then $b^{-1}\lambda^{-1}\Theta^{Rg_*K}F(d)$ is the left-exact homology edge of $F$ on the short complex of $B$ in degree $q$ [def-weil-pbc-left-exact-homology-edge]. This identifies only the derived direct-image local class with the ordinary section edge; it asserts no comparison with $g_*H^q(I)$.

source.place: cohomology.tex Tags 0BKJ (lemma-sheafification-cohomology), 0D5X (lemma-unbounded-describe-higher-direct-images), 079W (lemma-adjoint); derived.tex Tag 0156 (section-right-derived-functor). The kernel/cokernel and unit calculations are agent-derived.

proof.text: Apply the proved supplied-model Leray unit calculation to the fixed K-injective representative I and r=topEdgeResolutionIso.inv.

Take homology, using the specified hom of the local Leray isomorphism. Naturality of the fixed sheafification normalization transports the class map along d. Apply the local class formula for the section derived unit, which gives the ordinary sheafification class on B.

Precompose with the epimorphism from cycles. The ordinary cycle-class formula gives the inverse kernel comparison followed by F of the cycle quotient, which is the defining equation of the left-exact homology edge. Cancel the cycle quotient.

lean.statement:
theorem resolutionDirectImageClassModel {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) (q : ℤ)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory T) :
    let f := g.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F := RingedSpace.localAbelianSections S.toRingedSpace
    let I := RingedSpace.topEdgeResolution T.toRingedSpace K
    let J := ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    (RingedSpace.topEdgeInverseModel f q K).inv ≫
        (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray f q K).inv ≫
        RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalClass S.toRingedSpace q ((schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj K) ≫
        F.map (localClassDirectImageHomologyIso g q K).hom =
      ShortComplex.leftExactHomologyEdge F (J.sc q)
